selection_rule: Order models small-11, small-22, small-33, small-44, small-55, large-11, large-22, large-33, large-44, large-55. Take the first model with a false escape, then its largest positive margin, breaking ties by trial order. Require learned numerical escape and exact numerical capture. If integration disagrees, record the discrepancy and try the next ranked witness. If no false escape exists, take the first disagreement, otherwise the first nominal trial.
